name: Mole Bonk
tagline: Bonk the moles before anyone else does!
rules: Moles pop out of the holes for a moment.
Point at one and click (or tap it) to bonk it. Miss, and your mallet needs a moment to lift.
Most moles when time's up wins.

controls.keyboard: Point with the mouse · click to bonk
controls.touch: Tap a mole to bonk it
controls.gamepad: Stick to point · trigger or A to bonk
